messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Problem running analyse
parts:
Paulo

This problem arises frequently and has been discussed a number of times on this email list (most recently 14Oct2020).  The problem is for some versions of the Windows operating system, Windows complains (as it has for you).  The solution is to re-install Distance 7.3 into a directory that contains no spaces in the directory path.  When the installation software wants to know what directory to place the software, reply with something like C:/Distance

https://groups.google.com/g/distance-sampling/c/KxkoqM3dMQE/m/wv1Ciyd-AQAJ
